title: Build ELD telematics ingestion pipeline for carrier GPS pings
body:
Set up a pipeline that pulls GPS location pings from our partner carriers' ELD providers (Samsara, Motive) and writes them to the tracking database. This is the data backbone for **Project Atlas**.

**Scope**

* Webhook receivers for Samsara and Motive location events
* Normalize payloads into a common `location_ping` schema (load_id, lat, lng, speed, timestamp)
* Deduplicate pings and drop anything older than 24h
* Alert on ingestion lag over 5 minutes

**Definition of done**

* Pings from at least 3 pilot carriers visible in staging
* Runbook added to the on-call wiki
author: Abraham AIProject
